name: A Strange Artifact
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature.

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>
narrative.objectives: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
narrative.offerRewardText: You were right to bring this to me, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find something in the tower?
